verdict: Ads went dark Aug 6; restarting now on a proven engine.
narrative: All 43 leads and $1,024 in ad spend this period came before August 6 — Meta has been paused for 14 consecutive days since. That pause stopped a working campaign: in the final days before it went dark, your cost per lead was improving, reaching as low as $18 on the best days. Ads are being reactivated this week to restore that lead flow. In parallel, a gap between leads received and contacts logged in your CRM is being investigated to make sure no inbound inquiries are slipping through before the pipeline recovers.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all before the August 6 pause
average cost per lead this period, and trending lower before ads stopped
consecutive days with zero ad spend — the only real problem this period

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell 75% week over week, and organic reach dropped to zero in the last 7 days, compounding the impact of paid ads being paused.
watch_item.fix: A GBP posting cadence is being put in place by end of September to rebuild organic visibility, and the listing is being reviewed now for any technical issues.
